biography_english:
A Bakram who was queen consort to the Dynast-King. She was born into the noble House Eltynaha, and the King took her as his queen upon uniting Valeria under his rule. After learning her handmaiden Mannaflora was with child by the King, Vernotta had her exiled.
  She later bore the King a son, but the child perished in an accident. The distraught Queen was beset by illness, and passed away at the tender age of 30.
biography_spanish:
Una Bakram que fue reina consorte del Rey Dinasta. Nacio en la noble Casa Eltynaha y el Rey la tomo por reina al unificar Valeria bajo su mandato. Tras saber que su sirvienta Mannaflora esperaba un hijo del Rey, Vernotta la exilio.
  Mas tarde le dio un hijo al Rey, pero este perecio en un accidente. La afligida Reina sufrio una enfermedad y murio a la temprana edad de 30.

biography_english:
A Lodissian who led the armies of the Holy Lodissian Empire.  He was a man of great influence in Lodis, commanding five of the orders of knighthood there. He was father to the Dark Knight Balxephon and Hobyrim Steelsong.
  Seeking to have Lanselot Tartaros dismissed for fear that Loslorien would rise to power, he had his sons infiltrate the Dark Knights. However, Balxephon was swayed to Lanselot's side. Vogras then asked Loslorien to join forces with him, but was rebuffed. He was murdered by Balxephon soon after.
biography_spanish:
Un lodisiano que lidero los ejercitos del Sagrado Imperio Lodisiano. Era un hombre de gran influencia en Lodis, al mando de cinco ordenes de caballeria. Fue padre del Caballero Oscuro Balxephon y Hobyrim Steelsong.
  Buscando destituir a Lanselot Tartaros por temor al ascenso de Loslorien, hizo que sus hijos se infiltraran en los Caballeros Oscuros. Sin embargo, Balxephon fue atraido al bando de Lanselot. Vogras pidio a Loslorien unir fuerzas con el, pero fue rechazado. Balxephon lo asesino poco despues.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. He was brother to Baronet Bazin of Auslan, a town in the Coritanae marches. Sir Agares was sent to reinforce the Almorica garrison, who were struggling to hold off attacks by the Duke's men. Despite his noble upbringing he was an approachable and well-respected commander.
  He led the defense of Almorica Castle in place of the absent Consul Obdilord, but was slain by {hero} Pavel.
biography_spanish:
Galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Hermano del baronet Bazin de Auslan, pueblo de las marcas de Coritanae. Sir Agares fue enviado a reforzar la guarnicion de Almorica, que luchaba por contener ataques de hombres del duque. Pese a su cuna noble, era un comandante cercano y respetado.
  Lidero la defensa del castillo de Almorica sin el consul Obdilord, pero cayo ante {hero} Pavel.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who served her clan in battle. Her surname, Canaletto, indicates she was of the people who inhabit the thickly forested region near the headwaters of the Theron river. The nomadic Canaletto are known for their peaceful nature, and it is rare for them to take part in warfare. However, those who tire of following the old ways of the tribe have been known to leave, and Wynoa may have simply grown restless.
  Assigned to lead a relief party, she was treating High Commander Gatialo when she encountered {hero} Pavel and was killed.
biography_spanish:
Una galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Su apellido, Canaletto, indica que era de la gente que habita la frondosa region cercana a las fuentes del rio Theron. Los nomadas Canaletto son conocidos por su indole pacifica, y es raro que participen en la guerra. Sin embargo, quienes se cansan de seguir las viejas costumbres de la tribu suelen irse, y Wynoa quizas simplemente buscaba algo mas.
  Asignada a liderar un grupo de socorro, atendia al alto comandante Gatialo cuando se topo con {hero} Pavel y fue abatida.

biography_english:
A Bakram serving with the Tigers of Burnham.
  She was tasked with scouring the San Bronsa Ruins for the wondrous powers said to lie hidden there. Until the fall of Heim she belonged to a secret expedition squad reporting directly to Regent Morne. After the downfall of the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom she and a few allies joined the Tigers of Burnham.
  The Tigers are a faction of the Order of Philaha loyal to Brantyn who seek to rebuild the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom by locating the Apocrypha and a set of wondrous powers.
biography_spanish:
Una Bakram con los Tigres de Burnham.
  Debia explorar las Ruinas de San Bronsa buscando poderes prodigiosos ocultos alli. Hasta caer Heim estuvo en un grupo secreto de exploracion bajo el mando del regente Morne. Tras caer el Reino Bakram-Valeriano, ella y unos aliados se unieron a los Tigres de Burnham.
  Los Tigres, faccion de la Orden de Philaha leal a Brantyn, buscan rehacer el Reino Bakram-Valeriano hallando los Apocrifos y poderes prodigiosos.

  Vepahl located two of the powers at the San Bronsa Ruins, but was then slain by angelic forces.
biography_spanish:
Una Bakram que sirvio con los Tigres de Burnham.
  Su mision era explorar las Ruinas de San Bronsa buscando poderes prodigiosos ocultos alli. Hasta la caida de Heim pertenecio a un grupo secreto de exploracion a las ordenes del regente Morne. Tras caer el Reino Bakram-Valeriano, ella y unos aliados se unieron a los Tigres de Burnham.
  Los Tigres, faccion de la Orden de Philaha leal a Brantyn, buscaban rehacer el Reino Bakram-Valeriano hallando los Apocrifos y poderes prodigiosos.
  Vepahl hallo dos poderes en las Ruinas de San Bronsa, pero fue abatida por fuerzas celestiales.

biography_english:
A Bakram who is wed to the pirate Darza. She was born to nobility in Barnicia, but struck out on her own to escape the burden of her lineage. While at sea her ship was attacked by Darza's pirates, and she was taken to Ndamsa Fortress. She was unfazed by their threats of violence, and Darza grew fond of her spirited nature, keeping her always at his side. Veldrei eventually came to have feelings for Darza as well, and they married.
  At first she joined him on raids, but later stayed ashore to watch over their den after learning she carried Darza's child. Though usually calm and collected in front of the other pirates, she broke into tears upon hearing of Darza's death.
  She was defeated in battle by {hero} while attempting to avenge her husband's killing, but her life was spared.
biography_spanish:
Una Bakram casada con el pirata Darza. Nacio en la nobleza de Barnicia, pero partio sola para escapar de la carga de su linaje. En el mar, su barco fue atacado por los piratas de Darza y la llevaron a la Fortaleza Ndamsa. Sus amenazas de violencia no la inmutaron, y Darza se prendo de su firme caracter, teniendola siempre a su lado. Con el tiempo Veldrei tambien sintio algo por Darza y se casaron.
  Al principio lo seguia en sus incursiones, pero luego se quedo en tierra para cuidar su guarida tras saber que esperaba un hijo de Darza. Aunque solia mantener la calma ante los demas piratas, rompio en llanto al saber de la muerte de Darza.
  Fue derrotada en batalla por {hero} al intentar vengar a su esposo, pero le perdonaron la vida.
